meta.name: add-dial-number
meta.description: Add another phone number to an existing Dial channel — a second (or third) public line for the agent, so one NanoClaw install answers SMS and AI voice calls on multiple numbers. Use when Dial is already installed and the operator wants an additional number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). Requires the Dial channel to already be installed (see /add-dial).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让同一安装接听多个号码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要给现有直线添加额外接听号码
copy.tagline_en: Answer calls on multiple numbers from a single installation
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a Dial channel and need to add another number

howto.what: 给已装好的 Dial 渠道再加一个电话号码:每个号码是独立线程的线路,答复从收到消息的那个号码发出;一个 NanoClaw 安装可同时接多个号码的短信和 AI 语音。
howto.when: 当 Dial 渠道已经装好,你想再添一个号码(例如个人线加客服线)时触发。若还没装 Dial,需要先运行 /add-dial。

say.text: 给 Dial 再加一个号码:+14155550123
say.note: 先核对号码归属,再让你选接听的 agent

say.text: 列出这个 Dial 账户现有的号码
say.note: 显示已有号码,方便挑一个还没接入的

say.text: 把新号码设为 strict,只允许已知用户发消息
say.note: 只改该号码的策略,不影响已有线路

howto.what_en: Adds another phone number to an already-installed Dial channel. Each number is its own threaded line; replies leave from the number that received the message, and one NanoClaw install can answer SMS and AI voice calls on several numbers.
howto.when_en: Use when Dial is already installed and you want an extra number (e.g. a personal line plus a support line). If Dial is not installed, run /add-dial first.

say_en.note: It verifies the number, then asks which agent answers

say_en.text: List the Dial numbers on this account
say_en.note: Shows existing numbers so you can pick one not wired yet

say_en.text: Set the new line to strict, known users only
say_en.note: This policy applies only to the new number
